title: Cosmic Octopus in Bubble
description: A vibrant green cartoon octopus with a wide toothy grin stands in a grassy lakeside landscape, manipulating glowing purple and blue energy orbs with its tentacles. The entire surreal scene is enclosed within a large transparent spherical bubble crackling with purple lightning against a starry cosmic background.
prompt: A cheerful green cartoon octopus with big eyes and a wide toothy smile stands in a lush grassy field beside a small reflective pool, juggling glowing purple and blue energy orbs connected by crackling lightning. The entire scene is contained within a giant transparent bubble floating in outer space with stars and nebulae visible outside, vibrant colors, surreal fantasy landscape with distant lake and pine trees inside the bubble, whimsical and energetic atmosphere.
